title: The recent pullback provides some pretty good buying opportu
text:
The recent pullback provides some pretty good buying opportunities for long-term investors and short-term traders. Many stocks are down 10% or more. If you missed the train on some of them, this could be your chance.
Apple ( AAPL ) can be a good example. The stock was trading as high as $180 just few weeks ago, but is now down 15%+ from the recent highs. This is a buying opportunity many have been waiting for.
But if you are willing to implement some simple options strategies, you can do much better than just buying the stock outright at $155.
I'm talking about selling a naked put of course. The market risk of the naked put is identical to the market risk of a covered call. In fact, a naked put can be a much safer strategy than just buying the stock.
Strategy #1 - Naked Put 
Sell AAPL Sep. 2018 $130 put at $4.00 Selling the $130 September put would cost $4.00 and credit your account with $400. This money will remain at your account no matter what. 
If AAPL stays above $130 by September, you just keep the $400. If it trades lower, you will be assigned 100 shares of AAPL stock for each put contract you sold.

The trade would require $1,300 in margin. If the puts expire worthless, that means 30.7% return on margin in 7 months.
